title: BINOM.DIST: identified as R's dbinom_raw, scored in percentages and still open
status_plain: Lane 8 identified Excel's binomial pmf as R's dbinom_raw with three recovered source details, including log1p realized as two separate logarithms because msvcr100 exports none, and landed it. Every score published is a PERCENTAGE with no numerator: b29 rose from 8.76% to 49.81%, b34 gives 52.17%, b35 gives 75.51%, and the fresh b36 gate gives 49.59% overall. b29, b34 and b35 are fitted corpora; only b36 is fresh. The k-strata inside b36 -- 96.4% at k=n, 81.6% at k=0, 37.9% at general k -- are strata of that same gate, not separate surfaces. The row is open.

evidence_locality_note: Every W109 battery (b14, b19, b20, b21, b22, b26, b30, b31) lives under `smart-fuzzer/work/` or `smart-fuzzer/cache/`, both gitignored in OxFunc.
substrate: R's dbinom_raw: the lc grouping ((s(n)-s(k))-(s(n-k)+bd0(k,np)))-bd0(n-k,nq); lf = (M + ln k) + (ln(n-k) - ln n) with log1p ported as two separate logarithms; arg = lc - 0.5*lf at RN64 extended into the fFEXP chain
ruled_out: the chain itself as the error source: exonerated by the matched-argument b35 proof
open_question: Two things stay open: the second lc-flip source, 72 of 475 rows with DR-quotient rows suspect, and the small-operand bd0-direct smooth bodies.
reader_warning: Every headline number here is a percentage without a numerator, and this record refuses to compute one. 49.59% is a whole-surface fresh gate; 96.4%, 81.6% and 37.9% are k-strata inside it and are not separate surfaces or separate corpora.
